newsitem.title: TUNISIA: EU donates Tunisia 100 million Ecu for adjustment.
newsitem.headline: EU donates Tunisia 100 million Ecu for adjustment.

text.p: The European Union and Tunisia on Friday signed a convention by which the EU will donate Tunisia 100 million ecus to modernise its economy, European and Tunisian officials said.
The amount will contribute to the adjustment of the Tunisian economy to a free trade zone accord with the EU signed in 1995.
They said economic adjustment aims to reinforce long-term macro-economic stability, enlarge the private sector and boost competitiveness, and reform the financial sector.
Part of the aid will be used to partially compensate for the state budget loss of customs tax revenues as a consequence of the dismantling of barriers to EU products, officials said.
The state's draft budget for 1997 puts these losses at 70 million dinars ($70 million).
